country.match: Match each natural sight to its country.
country.odd: Three of these natural sights are in {value}. Which one isn't?

exclude.why: Bora Bora: Wikidata country is France; players think of French Polynesia

rows.label: Lake Baikal
rows.description: freshwater rift lake in southern Siberia, Russia; the greatest mountain lake in Asia and the most voluminous freshwater lake in the world
rows.hook: holds more fresh water than any other body of water on Earth and is the deepest in the world

rows.label: Mount Kilimanjaro
rows.description: mountain massif in Kilimanjaro National Park in Tanzania
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in Africa and the tallest free-standing one in the world

rows.label: Dolomites
rows.description: mountain range in the Alps

rows.label: Mount Whitney
rows.description: highest mountain in California and the contiguous United States
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in the lower 48 states

rows.label: Mount St. Helens
rows.description: volcano in Washington state
rows.hook: blew its top in a catastrophic eruption that sent ash across the Pacific Northwest

rows.label: Denali
rows.description: highest mountain in North America, located in Alaska
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in North America and was long known by the name of a US president

rows.label: Mount Vesuvius
rows.description: active stratovolcano in the Gulf of Naples, Italy
rows.hook: buried Pompeii and Herculaneum in ash when it erupted in ancient Roman times

rows.label: Mount Fuji
rows.description: volcano in Yamanashi and Shizuoka Prefectures, Japan
rows.hook: is a snow-capped, perfectly symmetrical volcano that serves as a cultural icon seen from Tokyo

rows.label: Galapagos Islands
rows.description: Archipelago in the Pacific Ocean, part of Ecuador since 1832
rows.hook: inspired Charles Darwin's thinking on evolution and are famous for giant tortoises and unique wildlife

rows.label: Mount Rainier
rows.description: stratovolcano in the U.S. state of Washington

rows.label: Mount Etna
rows.description: active stratovolcano on the east coast of Sicily, Italy
rows.hook: is one of the world's most active volcanoes and one of the tallest in Europe

rows.label: Mount Olympus
rows.description: mountain in Elassona municipality, Greece
rows.hook: was the legendary home of the twelve Greek gods

rows.label: Cappadocia
rows.description: historical region of Anatolia in Turkey

rows.label: Lake Como
rows.description: lake in Lombardy, Italy

rows.label: Bora Bora
rows.description: island in French Polynesia
rows.hook: is a honeymoon paradise with overwater bungalows in a lagoon around an extinct volcano

rows.label: Jeju Island
rows.description: island south of the Korean peninsula, part of the Jeju Special Autonomous Province of South Korea

rows.label: Mount Elbrus
rows.description: highest mountain of the Caucasus and highest mountain in Europe
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in Europe, a dormant volcano in the Caucasus

rows.label: Ben Nevis
rows.description: highest mountain of Great Britain
rows.hook: is the tallest peak in the British Isles, with a footrace up it each year

rows.label: Loch Ness
rows.description: lake in Highland, Scotland, UK, outflows via Loch Dochfour to the River Ness and Caledonian Canal
rows.hook: is the deep, dark home of a legendary monster called Nessie

rows.label: Mauna Loa
rows.description: volcano on the island of Hawaii in Hawaii, United States

rows.label: Lake District
rows.description: mountainous region in North West England, UK
rows.hook: is a famous region of hills and waterways tied to Beatrix Potter and the Romantic poets

rows.label: Grand Teton National Park
rows.description: United States National Park in northwestern Wyoming

rows.label: Cliffs of Moher
rows.description: cliffs in Western Ireland, on the Atlantic shore
rows.hook: are towering sea walls rising from the Atlantic, a top tourist draw and movie backdrop

rows.label: Sequoia National Park
rows.description: national park in the Sierra Nevada mountains, California, U.S.

rows.label: Mount Hood
rows.description: stratovolcano in the Cascade Volcanic Arc in Oregon, United States

rows.label: Zion National Park
rows.description: national park in Washington, Iron, and Kane counties in Utah, United States
rows.hook: is a canyon of towering red sandstone walls, famed for the Narrows and Angels Landing hikes

rows.label: Joshua Tree National Park
rows.description: national park of the United States

rows.label: White Cliffs of Dover
rows.description: chalk cliff coastline in Kent, UK
rows.hook: are a gleaming chalk wall facing France across the Channel, a symbol of coming home

rows.label: Teide
rows.description: volcano on Tenerife in the Canary Islands

rows.label: Banff National Park
rows.description: national park in Alberta, Canada
rows.hook: is a Rocky Mountains resort area with turquoise glacial waters, including Lake Louise

rows.label: Arches National Park
rows.description: national park in Grand County, Utah, United States

rows.label: Eyjafjallajökull
rows.description: ice cap in Iceland covering the caldera of a volcano

rows.label: Mount Tai
rows.description: mountain in Shandong, China

rows.label: Table Mountain
rows.description: mountain in Cape Town, South Africa
rows.hook: is a flat-topped peak overlooking Cape Town, reached by a rotating cable car

rows.label: Snowdonia
rows.description: mountainous area in Wales

rows.label: Bryce Canyon National Park
rows.description: national park in Garfield and Kane counties in Utah, United States
